primary_recommendation_reasons: Severe class imbalance (~2.18% positive rate) limits raw classification confidence.

PR-AUC remains low in both regimes (< 0.10 micro average precision), reflecting that cost revisions are administrative decisions driven by external fiscal and political approvals rather than purely project-internal metrics.
Neither model family achieves high reliable operational precision across all walk-forward folds.
Models should remain research-grade early warning signals rather than autonomous production gates.
